# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 12 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_012_page_001.jpg

---

## Vision 3, Chapter 4

**1** After fifteen days, when I had fasted and entreated the Lord earnestly, the knowledge of the writing was revealed to me. The writing was as follows: **2** "Your seed, Hermas, has sinned against God and has blasphemed against the Lord, and has betrayed their parents through great wickedness, and they were called betrayers of their parents; and though they betrayed them, they did not profit by it, but heaped more transgressions upon their own sins. **3** And there have been added even more riotous living and wanton wickedness, and so the transgressions of your children have been filled up. **4** But you know that God is merciful and that he will correct the sins of your house if you repent with your whole household, and you will humble yourselves before the Lord and serve him with pure hearts, and he will heal all your former sins." **5** "Do not be dismayed at your household's situation, but go on admonishing them. For just as a goldsmith refines his work, so also God refines his, especially those who are his." The message was complete.

---

*EMET note: Chapter 12 = Vision 3, Chapter 4 — the revelation of the writing in the book Hermas was shown. The book's content concerns his household's sins.*
